Benchmark knowledge evidence: missing weight data refers to weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg = NULL; difference = SUBTRACT(SUM(colour.id = 7), SUM(colour.id = 1)); blue eyes refers to eye_colour_id WHERE colour.id = 7; no eye color refers to eye_colour_id WHERE colour.id = 1;
